name: GL_AUTOREV_CRITERIA_SETS
description: GL_AUTOREV_CRITERIA_SETS contains the journal reversal criteria sets you create using the Journal Reversal Criteria Set form.  Each row includes the name and description of your set.  There is a one-to-many relationship between the journal reversal criteria sets stored in this table and the journal reversal criteria detail information stored in the GL_AUTOREVERSE_OPTIONS table.

columns.description: Auto reversal criteria set identifier.

columns.description: Auto reversal criteria set description.
